description: Use Orca's computer-use CLI for OS/window-level inspection and input in visible local app windows. Use when a task must read or operate a native app or an external browser window (for example, Chrome, Edge, or Safari) or an app webview. Do not use for Orca's embedded browser or page-only browser automation. Use `orca-cli` for Orca's embedded pages and a page-automation tool such as Playwright or CDP for external pages.
